subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier note about re-subscribing lapsed {Brand} users. One timely reason it matters: Apple's AdAttributionKit added overlapping re-engagement windows at WWDC 2025, so iOS win-backs are now measurable for remarketing partners. That reshapes the math when a healthy blended cost per trial for fitness apps runs 20 to 40 dollars, since a re-subscribed validated payer should cost less than a cold trial. We fire the validated event into both AAK and your postback, so MAFO bids toward payers who survive the refund window. Worth a compare on your win-back cost?
angle: fresh angle: AdAttributionKit re-engagement windows (WWDC 2025, sourced) + $20-40 cost-per-trial band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN health_and_fitness retargeting: acknowledges second follow-up and references prior note; fresh angle = timely development (AdAttributionKit overlapping re-engagement windows, WWDC 2025) + real sourced benchmark band (healthy blended cost per trial 20-40 USD, Airbridge); both source URLs retrieved and verified; no MobUpps figure this stage; exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; native English; no 'X, not Y'.
